liveProof.note: SMOKE_PROJECT is a top-level require_env of checkpoints.sh and must be set beside the spec's variables. gh must resolve to the daemon's worker-bin/gh shim (legion gh --); this pane predates worker-bin on PATH, so PATH was prefixed with <state_dir>/worker-bin for the run.

trickyParts: Author vs committer in a shared jj workspace: the author is inherited from whoever created the working-copy commit, the committer is the role that made the commit. Checkpoint 5 accepts either App on both fields and requires at least one implementer-committed commit; checkpoint 7 accepts either App on the deletion commit (spec v4 after the survey found 3/18 reviewer-committed deletions).

The two App logins contain regex-special brackets, so email matching splits on the first '+' and compares the remainder to '<login>@users.noreply.github.com' instead of interpolating the login into a regex.

gh api pages reviews 30 per request; #1007 (32 reviews) and #1024 have their approvals past page 1, so the old checkpoint 7 read falsely failed. pr_reviews uses gh api --paginate | jq -s 'add // []' and is shared with checkpoint 8. The fake gh proves the flag is passed (GH_LOG grep) and serves --paginate as concatenated pages (31-review case).
Acceptance 1's grep forbids the retired strings anywhere in scripts/smoke, so the negative fixtures use shapes that do not spell them (a trailer key mid-line; a feature/<KEY> head).

errexit is not inherited by $(...): a helper called only as var="$(helper)" keeps running after a failed gh unless the substitution itself carries `|| fail`. An assignment's status is the substitution's, so `var="$(gh …)" || fail …` works with errexit off inside the subshell.
deviations: Checkpoint 8's reviews read now goes through pr_reviews and its dead 'set SMOKE_PR' guard is gone (smoke_pr always returns a number or fails) -- the one change outside checkpoints 5 and 7, approved by the architect and recorded in spec v4.

Live proof ran against #1035 (LEGION-75), not the spec's example #1011 (LEGION-40), because #1011 has two commits without the Omp-Session trailer (cbab905d, 4e0742b5) -- reported to the architect, filed as LEGION-115; checkpoint 5 stays strict as the architect ruled.
